videos.title: 3 Foot Sweeps for No Gi BJJ (Judo/Wrestling/Jiu-Jitsu)
videos.whyUseful: Covers fundamental no-gi foot sweeps including de ashi barai, sasae tsurikomi ashi, and kouchi gari. Teaches the mechanics for setting up and timing sweeps against a resisting opponent in no-gi context.

videos.title: No Gi Judo Foot Sweeps 101
videos.whyUseful: No-gi entry into de-ashi-barai, kouchi and sasae: how to load the receiving foot and sweep it as the weight arrives.

videos.title: How to Hit a No Gi Foot sweep: De-Ashi Barai (BJJ/Judo/Jiu-Jitsu)
videos.whyUseful: Details the off-balancing grips and timing that make the de-ashi-barai land against a set stance.
